thread:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired for service=redwood-inference-runtime region=az2 severity=page - multiple nodes reporting NIC errors and controlplane heartbeats missing. link: https://pagerduty.example/INC-9247 :rotating_light:

mike (oncall): ack - I'm oncall, joining. seeing surge in 5xx and controlplane reconnects. p95 latency ~3.2s for text.generate in az2, request error rate 38%.

PagerDuty: Escalation queued: SRE lead -> on-call escalation in 4m.

Priya (SRE): looking at node metrics now. NIC counters showing RX drops + kernel logs with repeated 'link down' on eno2. suspect upstream fabric flapping in AZ2.

mike (oncall): starting controlled routing change to avoid AZ2 for new requests. will enable routing-policy:exclude-az2 on the router.

devops-bot: command issued by mike (oncall):
```
POST /api/v1/routing/policy HTTP/1.1
Host: controlplane.internal
Authorization: Bearer REDACTED
Content-Type: application/json

{"policy":"exclude-az2","scope":"global","reason":"az2 NIC errors 1765432101"}
```

Samir (SRE): ack - taking traffic routing handoff. I'll keep canaries enabled to AZ1/AZ3 only. Watchpoints: prefix-cache hit rate and KV-cache evictions.

Tara-SRE: enabling fallback model-variant (quantized-llama-q4) for latency-sensitive routes so customers still get responses while we drain AZ2. trigger: `./ops/fallback/enable --variant quantized-llama-q4 --routes "chat,completion"`

Eve-CS: curating live-customer-impact notes. Currently 12 customers on az2 dedicated capacity may see errors or degraded throughput. drafting short note for status.redwood.ai.

Priya (SRE): running node diagnostics:
```
for node in $(list-nodes --az az2 --role inference); do ssh $node 'sudo ethtool -S eno2 | egrep "rx_errors|tx_errors|rx_dropped"'; done
```
Results: multiple nodes show increasing rx_errors and `link_reset_count`. Kernel message snippet:
```
[ 1234.567890] eth2: link down
[ 1234.568001] mlx5_core 0000:03:00.0: NIC: port 2 link down
```

mike (oncall): starting node evacuations for the worst-off nodes - set `drain=true` and `no_new_alloc=true` in the scheduler for those hosts. keeps running in AZ2 but stops new workloads.

devops-bot: drain commands issued: `schedulerctl drain --node ip-az2-10-4-32-11 --reason "nic-flap"` (3 nodes)

Priya (SRE): autoscaler triggered adding 6 nodes in AZ1 and AZ3 as we shifted traffic, ramping up capacity. monitoring queue lag.

Samir (SRE): observed prefix-cache eviction spike after routing change; temporarily bumping cache size and enabling prefix bypass for fallback paths: `redis-cli CONFIG SET maxmemory 4gb` - closely monitoring memory pressure.

Eve-CS: sending initial customer-facing status: "We are investigating increased errors in az2 impacting inference in some regions. We're failing requests to alternate regions while root cause is investigated. No customer data exposure."

Priya (SRE): running a targeted fabric health check with infra team. asking network on-call to confirm if there is a known maintenance / fabric event for az2. pinging @net-oncall.

mike (oncall): PagerDuty shows auto-escalation in 2m if not acked by lead. Samir, can you take primary on-call while I handover? I need to step out for a quick coordination with CS.

Samir (SRE): taking primary. ack at 1765432150. I'll own mitigation and timeline.

PagerDuty: Incident owner updated -> Samir (SRE). automated note added to incident.

Tara-SRE: to reduce error budget burn, I'm turning on model variant fallback for the high-latency endpoints and briefly reducing max tokens for background batch jobs. command: `ops apply --env prod --tweak "batch.max_tokens=256"`

Priya (SRE): network on-call responded: "No scheduled maintenance. Observed brief microbursts causing RX queue overflow on select ToR uplinks in az2. Currently isolating ports for remediation."

Samir (SRE): initiating controlled failover for dedicated customer routes using `route-release` so committed capacity users are failed over to reserved pools in az1. leaving read-only traffic unaffected for now.

devops-bot: route-release logs:
```
[1765432198] released route: customer-pool-77 -> fallback-pool-3
[1765432201] released route: customer-pool-101 -> fallback-pool-3
```

Eve-CS: updating affected customer list: 9 dedicated customers still affected, 3 transient errors. prepping targeted outbound to top 5 customers with mitigation ETA ~30-45m.

mike (oncall): Can we get a tl;dr for execs? Samir: cause, impact, mitigation, ETA.

Samir (SRE): tl;dr: AZ2 fabric port flapping caused controlplane heartbeat loss and NIC errors -> 30-45% error rate for az2-backed inference; mitigations: route traffic away from az2, enable fallback quantized models for latency routes, drain worst nodes, autoscaler added capacity in az1/az3. ETA for full recovery depends on network fix; infra says 35-60m.

Tara-SRE: adding post-incident playbook note: consider proactively bumping ingress socket queue length on NICs in case of microburst-induced drops. filing a follow-up with infra.

Priya (SRE): after isolation by network team, flaps reduced on port group. doing controlled reintroduce: `schedulerctl undrain --node ip-az2-10-4-32-11` one at a time while observing error rates.

devops-bot: healthcheck summary at 1765432370: az2 error-rate down to 7%, p95 latency back to 600ms on reintroduced nodes.

Eve-CS: updated status page: "Errors substantially reduced; traffic shifted off of az2; targeted recovery ongoing. We'll follow up with root cause once network remediation completes."

mike (oncall): thanks team. I'm back and resuming oncall. Samir handing back at 1765432410.

Samir (SRE): handing back, leaving notes: drained 3 nodes, reintroduced 2 after network fix; fallback models still enabled until system stable for 1 hour.

PagerDuty: Incident acknowledged and marked as RESOLVED by Samir (SRE) at 1765432467. automated final note added.

incident-bot: Follow-up checklist created: postmortem owner=Priya(SRE), timeline pinned, notify infra and networking. link: https://wiki.internal/incidents/INC-9247/postmortem :memo:

Eve-CS: will send customer follow-up with timeline and mitigation steps once postmortem is available. :white_check_mark:

Tara-SRE: quick action items: (1) validate NIC driver versions on az2 fleet, (2) add socket queue tuning to runbook, (3) add a routing-canary to detect microbursts earlier.

mike (oncall): closing thread, leaving channel for any late follow-ups. :slightly_smiling_face:
